definitions.explanation: Reluctance to let go; continued attachment to something that is over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦カノ→カノ：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{未練|みれん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I still have feelings for my ex-girlfriend.

examples.japanese: {未練|みれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}る→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧。
⟦{未練|みれん}たらしい→未練たらしい：28628_mirentarashii⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}るな→取る：00565_toru⟧。

notes:
{未練|みれん} describes a lingering attachment to something that has ended.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {未練|みれん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have lingering feelings
- {未練|みれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}る→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧: to cut off lingering attachments
- {未練|みれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave regrets behind
- ⟦{未練|みれん}がましい→未練がましい：26851_mirengamashii⟧: clingy, showing inability to let go
- ⟦{未練|みれん}たらしい→未練たらしい：28628_mirentarashii⟧: pathetically attached

USAGE:
Often used about past relationships, jobs, or missed opportunities. Generally carries a negative connotation - suggesting inability to move forward.

NA-ADJECTIVE USAGE:
{未練|みれん}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: an attitude showing lingering attachment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未練|みれん}: regretful attachment (negative)
- ⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧: nostalgic (neutral/positive)
